pages.text: STATISTICAL ABSTRACT TRIPURA INTRODUCTION This ‘Statistical Abstract, Tripura—1970’ is the twelfth issue in the series, Like the previous issue, the present issue fulfils the need of making available comprehensive and detailed information relating to the various spheres of social and economic activities in the State. Data relating to the years 1961 to 1970 have been incorporated in the Abstract. Figures have been presented through out in metric units of weights and measures. The various section of the Abstract are precededs by brief explanatory notes which are intended to be read in conjunction with the tables. The Primary sources of data are indicated at the foot of each table. The Statistical Department is grateful to the various Departments and Non-government organisations which have co-operated in bringing out this publication. Dated, Agartala, J.
